text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The annual beachside summer training
camp is well underway, where
the students
are training harder than usual.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The sand provides such a different
experience from running on turf. I
can truly
feel the impact it's having on me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: All right, I should give it another—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did you hear there's gonna be a
festival held around here
tonight?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: There is? Let's go after training, then!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh, a festival? That sounds rather
charming.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I have some fond memories of going to
one when I was younger. It
was fun to see
all the stalls and activities on offer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ah, would that be all right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I'd best wrap up my training
quickly. I'll put everything
into this last
sprint.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After our training ends, McQueen and I
head to the festival grounds
as a golden
hue befalls the skies.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's all so lively!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
There are so many stalls that I almost don't
know where to start... Ah!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Um, would it be okay to take a look at
some of the stalls farther that
way?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Thank you! Let's be off, then.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I intend to follow right behind her, but as I
begin walking...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The crowds prove tricky to navigate, and I
bump into someone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
By the time that I am able to get my
bearings again, I have already
lost sight of
McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even after searching for a while, I am
unable to locate her in the sea
of people.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just then, the announcement system
comes online.

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
A lost person has come to the staff tent.
Mejiro McQueen is seeking
her trainer.
Please come to the event staff tent upon
hearing this
message.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh, there you are!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, it's all because I went on ahead
without so much as looking
back.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
This time I'll be sure to stick by your side
as we walk around...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I don't want to cause you any
more trouble...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Huh? That's... a rule?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, it would appear that everyone is
following the edict well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I have a request. Can we head
back towards the stalls I
had originally
taken an interest in?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I'd like you to join me in the festivities.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Just have to fish this little one out... Ha!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, the string snapped... Shopkeep, I'd
like to try again!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen has taken a keen interest
in the balloon fishing
game.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A short time later...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I did it, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I look over to see McQueen triumphantly
holding a festival balloon.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, that ended up being more of an
ordeal than I thought. I'm glad
I could
scoop it up in the end.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I could conquer any of the
games here. Let's head to the
next stall!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh, look over there! A shooting game! It
says they have premium
prizes as well!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what we can get... Shall we take a
look?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Trainer, come with me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After taking in all of the excitement that
the festival has to offer, we
decide to walk
back to the training camp grounds
together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for accompanying me
tonight. It was very
enjoyable.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: That's not true! Well, how do I put this?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
If anyone else had come along, I certainly
wouldn't have "let loose,"
as you
mentioned.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
As a Mejiro, I've always strived to maintain
a certain level of decorum
at all times.
However...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
If I'm with you, I... I feel like I can afford to
relax a bit.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: You don't mind that, do you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That makes me so happy to hear! I have
another request, then.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Would you care to take a bit of a stroll
with me? We can eat these
carrot sponge
cakes I purchased along the way.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Normally, I would consider eating while
walking to be poor manners,
but it's just
you and me out here tonight...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, thank you! All right then, please go
ahead and help yourself.
